summary: Our results show that contrastive learning outperforms a classification-based approach to authorship verification under the tested settings. We identify loss function, batch size, training duration, pre-trained model, input context length, and random text span data augmentation as important factors of model performance. Based on these considerations, we develop a ModernBERT Bi-Encoder model that achieves 98.4% accuracy on the PAN21 authorship verification task.
title: Contrastive Learning for Authorship Verification

title_translated: 基于对比学习的作者身份验证
summary_translated: 实验结果表明，在测试条件下，对比学习在作者身份验证任务上优于基于分类的方法。我们识别出损失函数、批量大小、训练时长、预训练模型、输入上下文长度以及随机文本片段数据增强是影响模型性能的重要因素。基于这些考虑，我们开发了ModernBERT双编码器模型，在PAN21作者身份验证任务上达到了98.4%的准确率。

summary: This work addresses continuous depression-severity score prediction from clinical interview transcripts under data scarcity. We propose a sequential low-rank adaptation (LoRA) protocol for cross-scale transfer: a Qwen3 backbone with a bounded regression head is first fine-tuned on the English DAIC-WOZ dataset (189 avatar-mediated sessions, PHQ-8), and the adapter then initializes fine-tuning on the Chinese PDCH dataset (100 real clinical consultations, HAMD-17), where a reinitialised, scale-specific head predicts the clinician-assigned score. All configurations use patient-level stratified 5-fold, 2-repeat cross-validation. On the data-scarce HAMD-17 target, the sequential protocol attains the best point-estimate MAE , RMSE, and macro-$F_1$ on both 0.6B and 1.7B backbones, outperforming target-only training and non-LLM baselines---4.96/6.59/0.36 with Qwen3-0.6B and 4.38/5.62/0.46 with Qwen3-1.7B. Ablations suggest that correctly aligned source supervision gives the best point estimates (unsupervised exposure and shuffled-label controls also show partial gains), that native-Chinese target input outperforms machine-translated English input, and that the reversed order yields no clear gain within run-to-run variance. The study is an exploratory, single-site internal evaluation: it does not establish screening or diagnostic utility, nor separately identify the contribution of the scale, language, or paradigm shifts. To our knowledge, no prior study evaluates this specific DAIC-WOZ-to-PDCH sequential transfer setting.
title: Cross-Scale Transfer Learning for Depression Severity Prediction: From PHQ-8 to HAMD-17 Across Languages and Clinical Paradigms
title_translated: 跨尺度迁移学习用于抑郁严重程度预测：从PHQ-8到HAMD-17跨越语言与临床范式
summary_translated: 本研究针对临床访谈转录文本在数据稀缺情况下的连续抑郁严重程度评分预测问题。我们提出一种顺序低秩适应（LoRA）协议实现跨尺度迁移：以Qwen3为基础模型，先在英文DAIC-WOZ数据集（189个虚拟角色会话，使用PHQ-8量表）上微调，随后适配器在中文PDCH数据集（100次真实临床咨询，使用HAMD-17量表）上初始化微调，重新初始化一个与量表相关的回归头来预测临床医生评定的分数。所有配置均采用患者级别的分层5折交叉验证，重复两次。在数据稀缺的HAMD-17目标任务上，该顺序协议在0.6B和1.7B两个规模的骨干模型上均取得了最佳点估计指标（MAE、RMSE和宏F1），优于仅针对目标数据训练和非大模型基线方法——Qwen3-0.6B为4.96/6.59/0.36，Qwen3-1.7B为4.38/5.62/0.46。消融实验表明，正确对齐的源端监督能带来最优点估计（无监督暴露和标签打乱控制也显示出部分提升），且原生中文输入优于机器翻译后的英文输入，而反向顺序在运行间方差内未表现出明显优势。本研究为探索性单中心内部评估，未建立筛查或诊断效用，也未单独区分量表、语言或范式转换的贡献。据我们所知，尚无先前研究评估此特定DAIC-WOZ到PDCH的顺序迁移设置。

summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled agents to tackle long-horizon tasks across diverse environments. To further improve agent performance, existing language world models typically predict environment observations, yet reconstructing high-entropy, execution-dependent tool responses offers limited value when real feedback is available. Meanwhile, agents suffer from \emph{task-state contamination}, where unsupported assumptions and outdated plans persist in history and distort subsequent decisions. We propose the \textbf{Agent-Editing World Model (AEWM)}, which models how reasoning and actions shape future task progress rather than simulating tool responses. AEWM combines \textbf{Action Judge} to distinguish \textsc{Critical}, \textsc{Exploratory}, and \textsc{Noisy} decisions with \textbf{State Revision} to edit noisy reasoning--action continuations from the same observed history. \textbf{EditAct} integrates these capabilities with real execution, directly changing the state underlying subsequent decisions rather than merely providing critiques. We train AEWM across Search, Terminal, and Software Engineering through mid-training and supervised fine-tuning. AEWM achieves 70.5\% macro-F1 on our Action Judge benchmark, exceeding the strongest frontier baseline by 10.6 points. Across six benchmarks and three agent backbones, EditAct improves average scores by 3.2--6.7 points over the strongest baseline. Furthermore, rejection sampling fine-tuning on verified EditAct trajectories, termed \textbf{AEWM-RFT}, improves over Self-RFT by 2.2--2.6 points across three domains without online AEWM guidance.
title: Agent-Editing World Model: Rethinking World Modeling for LLM Agents
title_translated: 智能体编辑世界模型：重新思考大语言模型智能体的世界建模
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展使智能体能够在多样化环境中处理长周期任务。为进一步提升智能体性能，现有语言世界模型通常预测环境观测结果，但在实际反馈可用时，重建高熵、执行依赖的工具响应价值有限。同时，智能体面临任务状态污染问题，即历史中持续存在的不支持假设和过时计划会扭曲后续决策。我们提出**智能体编辑世界模型（AEWM）**，其建模重点在于推理与行动如何塑造未来的任务进展，而非模拟工具响应。AEWM结合**动作判断器**以区分关键、探索性和噪声型决策，以及**状态修订机制**，用于修正来自相同观测历史的噪声推理-行动延续。**EditAct**将这些能力与真实执行整合，直接修改支撑后续决策的状态，而非仅提供批判意见。我们在搜索、终端和软件工程任务中通过中期训练和监督微调训练AEWM。AEWM在我们的动作判断基准上达到70.5%的宏F1，比最强前沿基线高出10.6个百分点。在六个基准和三种智能体骨干模型上，EditAct相较最强基线平均得分提升3.2至6.7分。此外，在经验证的EditAct轨迹上进行拒绝采样微调（称为**AEWM-RFT**），在三个领域内相比Self-RFT提升2.2至2.6分，且无需在线AEWM指导。

summary: Fine-tuning large language models on parallel data improves translation quality but can cause catastrophic forgetting. Mitigation methods are generally evaluated by retention on general benchmarks. We ask whether these findings transfer to machine translation (MT) fine-tuning and to MT-specific instruction following (MT-IF): instructions that modify a translation, such as formality, grammatical gender, and length control. We compare methods anchored to auxiliary data, to model outputs, and to the base model parameters, first in a screening study with Llama 3.2 1B Instruct, then on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct fine-tuned on bidirectional Arabic-English or Spanish-English data. Elastic Weight Consolidation preserves general capabilities best in both stages; on the 8B Spanish model the average score on general benchmarks drops 1.7 points versus 11.0 for standard fine-tuning, yet its scores for formality and grammatical gender control remain close to standard fine-tuning. Only data mixing with control-task examples preserves these controls, but its gains do not transfer to unseen prompts for the same task.
title: Fine-Tuning LLMs for Translation: General Forgetting Mitigation Does Not Preserve MT-Specific Instruction Following
title_translated: 大语言模型翻译微调：通用遗忘缓解无法保持机器翻译特定指令遵循能力
summary_translated: 在平行语料上对大语言模型进行微调可提升翻译质量，但可能导致灾难性遗忘。现有缓解方法通常通过通用基准上的保留能力进行评估。我们探讨这些发现是否适用于机器翻译（MT）微调及MT特定指令遵循（MT-IF）：如正式程度、语法性别和长度控制等修改翻译的指令。我们在Llama 3.2 1B Instruct模型上进行筛选研究，随后在Llama 3.1 8B Instruct模型上针对双向阿拉伯语-英语或西班牙语-英语数据进行微调。弹性权重巩固（Elastic Weight Consolidation）在两个阶段均最好地保留了通用能力；在8B西班牙语模型上，通用基准平均得分仅下降1.7分，而标准微调下降11.0分，但其正式程度和语法性别控制得分仍接近标准微调。只有混合控制任务示例的数据方法能保持这些控制能力，但其增益无法泛化到未见过的同任务提示。

summary: This study highlights the distribution of Standard Arabic (SA; H(igh) variety) and Colloquial Arabic (CA; L(ow) variety) across X and Facebook. 16754 public posts were collected via Python, with 10000 retained as the net dataset. Posts were classified into 7 discourse categories: *politics, technology, science, business, culture, fun,* and *sports*. Bivariate analyses, including Chi-square tests and Cramer's V (CV), examined associations among platform, discourse category, and diglossic choice, while binary logistic regression with Platform x Discourse Category interactions tested whether these associations varied across platforms. Findings reveal that there are significant associations between discourse category and diglossic choice on X, chi-square(6, *N* = 5000) = 600.35, p < .001, CV = .347, and Facebook, chi-square(6, N = 5000) = 1249.52, p < .001, CV = .500. Across platforms, platform was also associated with diglossic choice, chi-square(1, N = 10000) = 262.16, p < .001, CV = .162. Binary logistic regression further shows higher odds of SA use on X than Facebook in the political reference category (*OR* = 1.31, p = .0028), with significant platform-by-domain interactions for Culture (OR = 2.65), Fun (*OR* = 6.34), Sports (*OR* = 26.71), Science (OR = 0.41), and Technology (OR = 0.71). The study concludes that the diglossic use of SA and CA contributes to the growing body of research on digital discourse, unveiling that the digital age reshapes but does not erode diglossic boundaries, giving rise instead to a reconfigured digital diglossia.
title: Digital diglossia: Arabic between X and Facebook
title_translated: 数字双言现象：阿拉伯语在X平台与Facebook之间
summary_translated: 本研究揭示了标准阿拉伯语（SA；高变体）与方言阿拉伯语（CA；低变体）在X平台与Facebook上的分布情况。通过Python收集了16,754条公开帖子，保留10,000条作为净数据集。帖子被划分为7类话语类别：政治、科技、科学、商业、文化、娱乐和体育。采用双变量分析（包括卡方检验和Cramer's V系数）考察平台、话语类别与双言选择之间的关联，同时使用包含平台×话语类别的二元逻辑回归检验这些关联是否随平台变化。结果显示，在X平台上存在显著的类别与双言选择关联（χ²(6, N=5000)=600.35, p<.001, CV=.347），在Facebook上同样显著（χ²(6, N=5000)=1249.52, p<.001, CV=.500）。跨平台分析显示，平台本身也与双言选择显著相关（χ²(1, N=10000)=262.16, p<.001, CV=.162）。二元逻辑回归进一步表明，在政治话题中，X平台使用标准阿拉伯语的几率高于Facebook（OR=1.31, p=.0028），且在文化（OR=2.65）、娱乐（OR=6.34）、体育（OR=26.71）、科学（OR=0.41）和技术（OR=0.71）领域存在显著的平台-领域交互效应。研究结论认为，标准阿拉伯语与方言阿拉伯语的数字双言使用丰富了数字话语研究，揭示出数字时代重塑而非消解双言边界，催生了一种重构的数字双言现象。

summary: Meaning identity (whether two sentences say the same thing after wording changes) is treated in retrieval and RAG as a geometric fact about independently encoded sentence vectors. We show that, for frozen off-the-shelf encoders and language models, it is not: identity is computed when both sentences share one forward pass, and is not a property of the embedding geometry those systems ship. On overlap-matched PAWS-X, purpose-built encoders (BGE, E5, GTE, MiniLM, E5-Mistral-7B) reach English confirm AUC only 0.55-0.65 (dense peak 0.70). Independently encoded last-token states of Llama 3, Mistral, and Qwen do no better; late fusion of the two vectors stays near chance. The same probe on a joint forward pass reaches 0.90-0.96 from 1.5B to 32B, collapses under partner shuffle, is mid-depth, saturates near 0.94 by 3B, and appears more weakly in GPT-2 XL (0.76). The gap holds beyond Llama-style models on other causal LMs, bidirectional encoders (DeBERTa, RoBERTa), and encoder-decoders (Flan-T5, T5, BART). Fixed or linear readers over frozen independent encodings never unlock identity; nonlinear pair readers recover part of it only on the full 49k-pair PAWS train split (0.68-0.87). Off-the-shelf rerankers split: BGE-reranker-large reaches 0.94, while MS-MARCO and Jina stay at 0.55-0.64. Independently trained families compute the same relation and a 1.5B joint reader can distill it from unlabelled teacher scores, while no linear function of the teachers own independent vectors can. Bi-encoders can be fine-tuned to fit PAWS (0.87-0.93), but transfer and STS-B suffer. Cosine compares wording neighbourhoods; identity is a cheap computed operator, not a property of either sentence vector.
title: Computation Over Geometry: Meaning Identity Is Computed, Not Shipped in the Embeddings

title_translated: 几何上的计算：语义同一性是计算所得，而非嵌入中携带的
summary_translated: 语义同一性（即句子在词语变化后是否表达相同含义）在检索和RAG中被视为独立编码句子向量的几何事实。我们发现，对于冻结的现成编码器和语言模型而言，这并不成立：同一性是在两个句子共享一次前向传播时被计算出来的，而不是这些系统所传递的嵌入几何属性。在重叠匹配的PAWS-X数据集上，专门设计的编码器（BGE、E5、GTE、MiniLM、E5-Mistral-7B）仅达到0.55-0.65的英文确认AUC（密集峰值为0.70）。Llama 3、Mistral和Qwen的独立编码最后标记状态表现也不佳；对两个向量进行后期融合仍接近随机水平。而在联合前向传播的探测中，从1.5B到32B的模型达到了0.90-0.96的性能，伙伴打乱后性能崩溃，处于中间深度，3B左右趋于饱和（约0.94），GPT-2 XL中表现较弱（0.76）。该差距在其他因果语言模型、双向编码器（DeBERTa、RoBERTa）以及编码器-解码器模型（Flan-T5、T5、BART）中依然存在。对冻结独立编码使用固定或线性读取器始终无法解锁同一性；非线性配对读取器仅在完整的49k对PAWS训练集上部分恢复该能力（0.68-0.87）。现成重排序器的表现分化明显：BGE-reranker-large达到0.94，而MS-MARCO和Jina则维持在0.55-0.64。独立训练的模型家族能计算出相同关系，且一个1.5B的联合读取器可从未标注教师分数中蒸馏出该关系，但教师自身独立向量的任意线性函数都无法实现这一点。双编码器可通过微调适配PAWS（0.87-0.93），但迁移能力和STS-B任务表现下降。余弦相似度比较的是词语邻域，而同一性是一种廉价的计算操作，而非任一句子向量的属性。

summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have attracted significant attention for their strong reasoning ability. However, under a bidirectional attention mechanism, DLMs operate over an exponentially large exploration space compared to autoregressive models (ARMs), making it challenging to focus on reasoning-guiding tokens under random masking. We define causal shortcuts as token chains that cover the full sequence and provide explicit guidance towards correct reasoning trajectories. We analyze the effects of causal shortcuts on the reasoning accuracy and convergence speed of DLMs, and find that they largely improve answer convergence efficiency and generation accuracy. Motivated by this, we propose a Causal Shortcut Learning (CSL) Framework for DLMs. Specifically, we introduce a step-by-step token extraction procedure to extract causal shortcuts from data, and apply parallel prioritized masking on these tokens during training to enable efficient and accurate convergence to correct answers via causal shortcuts. Extensive experiments across multiple reasoning benchmarks and two base models demonstrate that CSL consistently outperforms existing SFT-variant baselines, achieving an average improvement of $1.92\%$ over SFT-only models, and up to $4.20\%$ on MATH-500. The code is available at the \href{https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning}{https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning
title: Towards Efficient Reasoning: Learning Causal Shortcuts for Diffusion Language Models
title_translated: 迈向高效推理：扩散语言模型的因果捷径学习
summary_translated: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）因其强大的推理能力受到广泛关注。然而，在双向注意力机制下，与自回归模型相比，DLMs需在指数级庞大的探索空间中运行，使得在随机掩码下难以聚焦于引导推理的关键标记。我们定义因果捷径为覆盖完整序列并明确引导正确推理路径的标记链。分析表明，因果捷径显著提升了DLMs的推理准确率和收敛速度。受此启发，我们提出一种针对DLMs的因果捷径学习（CSL）框架。具体而言，通过逐步标记提取程序从数据中提取因果捷径，并在训练过程中对这些标记应用并行优先掩码，以实现通过因果捷径高效且准确地收敛至正确答案。在多个推理基准和两种基础模型上的大量实验表明，CSL持续优于现有SFT变体基线，平均比仅SFT模型提升1.92%，在MATH-500上最高达4.20%。代码已公开于https://github.com/ZJUDianJin/Causal-Shortcuts-Learning。

summary: Weight-space post-training quantization (PTQ) must choose finite formats, granularities, quantizer families, transformations, and bits before the completed quantized model reveals its output-distribution drift. Existing PTQ methods predict important pieces of this degradation, including reconstruction error, Hessian sensitivity, transformation effects, and downstream loss, but these pieces are usually scored after fixing the quantization geometry or inside separate configuration families. We formulate weight-space PTQ as pre-deployment configuration selection using priced layer-output error. Each admissible layer configuration is treated as an error generator with a deployment cost, which induces a layer-output error covariance $\boldsymbolΣ_l(α_l)$, and the full-precision model prices that covariance by downstream curvature, $\widehatρ_l(α_l)=\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{Tr}\left(\widehat{\mathbf{H}}_l\,\widehat{\boldsymbolΣ}_l(α_l)\right)$. The price follows from full-precision-to-quantized forward KL, whose first-order term cancels at the reference model. It turns reconstruction and diagonal scores into reduced proxies that drop price factors, while finite formats, codebooks, granularities, and equivalent transformations become comparable candidates through the covariances they induce and the costs they pay. A trace reduction then yields a calibration-time price table and a budgeted price-guided selector, making fixed-geometry bit allocation a special case rather than the organizing problem.
title: Predicting Quantization Price for Selecting PTQ Configurations Before Deployment
title_translated: 预测量化价格以在部署前选择PTQ配置
summary_translated: 权重空间的训练后量化（PTQ）必须在完成量化模型揭示其输出分布漂移之前，预先选定有限的格式、粒度、量化器族、变换方式和比特数。现有PTQ方法虽能预测该退化过程中的关键部分，如重建误差、海森敏感性、变换影响和下游损失，但这些评估通常在固定量化几何结构或独立配置族内完成。我们将权重空间PTQ建模为基于带价层输出误差的部署前配置选择问题。每个可接受的层配置被视为一个误差生成器并带有部署成本，由此引出层输出误差协方差矩阵 $\boldsymbolΣ_l(α_l)$，全精度模型通过下游曲率对这一协方差进行定价，$\widehatρ_l(α_l)=\frac{1}{2}\operatorname{Tr}\left(\widehat{\mathbf{H}}_l\,\widehat{\boldsymbolΣ}_l(α_l)\right)$。该价格源自全精度到量化前向KL散度，其一阶项在参考模型处抵消。这使重建和对角评分转化为降低价格因子的简化代理，而有限格式、码本、粒度及等效变换则通过其所诱导的协方差和支付成本成为可比候选。通过迹缩减，我们得到校准阶段的价格表和预算导向的价格选择器，使固定几何比特分配变为特例而非核心问题。

summary: At test time, large language models (LLMs) can encode historical information in activation memory (i.e., KV caches) and parametric memory (i.e., updated parameters). While activation memory is generally considered effective for factual recall and parametric memory for learning new tasks, their interplay remains unclear. In this work, we systematically investigate the role of memory in few-shot learning through controlled experiments. We find that activation memory is superior for recalling facts, whereas parametric memory does not consistently outperform activation memory in task learning. Moreover, our experiments show that the composite task, Conditional Arithmetic, requires the synergy of both memory types. Through neuron-level analysis, we find that the model activates distinct sets of neurons when accessing the same historical information through activation versus parametric memory. When both memory types are combined, the model recruits neurons from both sets, which is crucial for solving Conditional Arithmetic. These findings suggest that neither memory mechanism alone is sufficient for this composite task, highlighting the importance of their collaboration.
title: Complementary Roles of Activation and Parametric Memory in Few-Shot Learning
title_translated: 激活记忆与参数记忆在少样本学习中的互补作用
summary_translated: 在测试阶段，大语言模型（LLMs）可通过激活记忆（即KV缓存）和参数记忆（即更新后的参数）编码历史信息。尽管激活记忆通常被认为在事实回忆中更有效，而参数记忆在学习新任务方面更具优势，但两者之间的相互作用仍不清晰。本文通过受控实验系统研究了记忆在少样本学习中的作用。结果表明，激活记忆在事实召回方面表现更优，而参数记忆在任务学习中并未始终优于激活记忆。此外，我们的实验显示，复合任务“条件算术”需要两种记忆类型的协同作用。通过神经元层面分析发现，当通过激活记忆或参数记忆访问相同历史信息时，模型会激活不同的神经元集合。当两种记忆类型结合使用时，模型会同时调动这两组神经元，这对解决条件算术任务至关重要。这些发现表明，单一记忆机制不足以完成此类复合任务，凸显了二者协作的重要性。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance in creative text generation, yet their ability to produce culturally grounded and stylistically constrained literary forms remains underexplored. Prior work has focused largely on modern language varieties and poetry, while classical prose traditions such as maqama remain largely unstudied. The maqama is a classical literary genre characterized by rhymed prose (saj), dense rhetorical ornamentation, and episodic narrative structure, making it a challenging testbed for evaluating whether LLMs can move beyond surface fluency toward deeper literary competence. In this paper, we present the first controlled evaluation study of maqama generation with LLMs, comparing five models under zero-shot, few-shot, and rule-based prompting, and evaluating outputs through both human annotation and an LLM-as-a-judge framework across dimensions such as rhetorical richness, saj density, structural coherence, and stylistic authenticity. Our results show that prompting strategy plays a strong role in stylistic quality: few-shot prompting most consistently improves saj density, while its effects on rhetoric and coherence vary by model, with the strongest models (GPT-4o and GPT-5.4-mini) benefiting most from rule-based prompting on these dimensions, though zero-shot prompting yields the highest aggregate scores across all five models. We further observe systematic differences between models in stylistic alignment with Arabic maqama conventions, and corroborate our findings with a second independent LLM judge, paired statistical significance testing, and non-LLM proxy measures of saj.
title: Beyond Poetry: Can Large Language Models Generate Classical Arabic Maqamat?
title_translated: 超越诗歌：大语言模型能否生成古典阿拉伯马卡玛文体？
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在创意文本生成方面表现出色，但其生成具有文化根基和风格约束的文学形式的能力仍缺乏充分探索。以往研究主要集中在现代语言变体和诗歌上，而古典散文传统如马卡玛（maqama）则鲜有研究。马卡玛是一种古典文学体裁，特征包括押韵散文（saj）、密集修辞装饰和分段叙事结构，是检验LLMs是否能超越表面流畅性、实现深层文学能力的理想测试场。本文首次对LLMs生成马卡玛进行了受控评估研究，比较了五种模型在零样本、少样本和规则提示下的表现，并通过人工标注和LLM作为评判者框架，从修辞丰富度、saj密度、结构连贯性和风格真实性等多个维度进行评价。结果表明，提示策略对风格质量有显著影响：少样本提示最一致地提升了saj密度，而对修辞和连贯性的影响因模型而异，最强模型（GPT-4o和GPT-5.4-mini）在这些维度上最受益于规则提示，尽管零样本提示在所有五种模型中综合得分最高。我们还观察到模型间在风格与阿拉伯马卡玛惯例的一致性上存在系统性差异，并通过第二位独立LLM评判者、配对统计显著性检验以及非LLM代理的saj测量方法进一步验证了研究发现。

summary: Closed-loop revision is increasingly used in large language model (LLM) applications, but failures may reflect incomplete feedback or ineffective responses to correct feedback. We introduce a fixed-budget revision protocol with deterministic verifiers that report all remaining violations across exact-length, lexical, and compositional constraints. Fixing feedback correctness and completeness isolates model-side revision behavior. Across 19 open- and closed-source models, controller-level mean final joint success ranges from 17.4% to 99.8%, with substantial cross-model gaps persisting under identical initial drafts. Controlled experiments reveal reproducible model-specific responses to exact feedback. Post-training and scale reshape these responses without consistently bringing them closer to exact correction. Across all constraint families, failed trajectories often repeat earlier outputs, and prior recurrence is associated with lower subsequent recoverability. Matched-state interventions show that removing earlier dialogue while holding the current draft and feedback fixed changes recurrence escape without reliably improving final success; effects depend on the model, task, and trigger-state composition. Exact feedback makes revision errors observable, but does not make the closed loop reliable. Code and reproduction instructions: https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/exact-feedback-code.
title: Exact Feedback Is Not Control: Evaluating Text-based Closed-Loop Revision in LLMs
title_translated: 精确反馈并非控制：评估大语言模型中的文本闭环修订
summary_translated: 闭环修订在大型语言模型（LLM）应用中日益普遍，但失败可能源于反馈不完整或对正确反馈的响应无效。我们提出一种固定预算的修订协议，采用确定性验证器报告所有剩余的违反项，涵盖精确长度、词汇和组合约束。通过固定反馈的正确性和完整性，隔离了模型自身的修订行为。在19个开源与闭源模型中，控制器级别的平均最终联合成功率范围为17.4%至99.8%，即使在相同初始草稿下，跨模型差距依然显著。受控实验揭示了模型对精确反馈的可复现的特定响应。训练后调整和规模扩展重塑了这些响应，但并未一致地使其更接近精确修正。在所有约束类别中，失败轨迹常重复早期输出，先前重复与后续可恢复性较低相关。匹配状态干预表明，在保持当前草稿和反馈不变的前提下，移除早期对话虽能改变重复逃逸，却无法可靠提升最终成功率；其效果取决于模型、任务和触发状态组成。精确反馈使修订错误可见，但并未使闭环系统变得可靠。代码与复现说明：https://github.com/kevinjiang0121-cyber/exact-feedback-code。

summary: In this paper, we introduce a gradient-based head attribution strategy where the Token-level Max-Margin loss is backpropagated to the attention maps. This framework enables a large-scale causal analysis of attention heads, making it suitable for LLMs. We evaluate our method on the task of disambiguation in Context-aware Machine Translation, where we analyze 50 phenomena across 4 models and 4 language directions. We empirically show the alignment of our method with the effects of increasing the attention scores of token-to-token relations on three models and two language directions, ensuring the robustness of our method. Our analysis reveals the presence of the "general-purpose" attention heads that improve the model's performance when attending to different relations. We find that the average attention a head assigns to a relation does not necessarily relate to the model's performance, which suggests that the models developed redundancies during training in terms of the head functions.
title: Scaling Attention Head Analysis via Gradient-Based Attribution in Context-Aware Machine Translation
title_translated: 基于梯度归因的注意力头分析在上下文感知机器翻译中的规模化应用
summary_translated: 本文提出一种基于梯度的注意力头归因策略，将词级最大间隔损失反向传播至注意力图。该框架支持大规模因果分析注意力头，适用于大语言模型。我们在上下文感知机器翻译中的消歧任务上评估该方法，分析了4个模型和4种语言方向下的50种现象。实证结果表明，我们的方法在三个模型和两个语言方向上与提升词对关系注意力得分的效果高度一致，验证了方法的稳健性。分析揭示存在‘通用型’注意力头，当模型关注不同关系时可提升性能。我们发现，注意力头对某一关系的平均注意力分配并不必然与模型性能相关，这表明模型在训练过程中对注意力头功能产生了冗余。

summary: Backtest auditing is a calibration problem: high flaw recall is not useful when the model falsely flags matched clean strategies. We build a 96-item paired benchmark in which every flawed backtest has a clean control that holds strategy, dates, code style, labels, and reporting scaffold fixed while changing one methodology detail. A deterministic scorer separates flaw recall, clean-control false positives, evidence localization, and fix relevance. Over 1440 cached audits from four text endpoints, the primary DeepSeek auditor reaches 100.0\% closed and clean-aware code recall, but open prompts over-flag 93.8\% of clean code controls, and clean-aware all-three specificity is 87.5\% even where recall saturates. A clean-aware warning drops DeepSeek code false positives from 20.8\% (95\% CI 11.7--34.3) to 0.0\% (0.0--7.4) at unchanged recall, while the budget anchor still flags 38/48 clean controls under the same prompt. Reporting recall alone would rank three of these four models identically; reporting the clean-control rate separates them by 79 points.
title: Can LLMs Catch a Rigged Backtest? A Clean-Control Calibration Benchmark
title_translated: 大语言模型能否识别被操纵的回测？一个干净对照校准基准
summary_translated: 回测审计是一个校准问题：当模型错误地标记了匹配的干净策略时，高缺陷召回率并无实际意义。我们构建了一个包含96个配对项目的基准测试，每个有缺陷的回测都对应一个干净对照，该对照保持策略、日期、代码风格、标签和报告结构不变，仅改变一个方法学细节。一个确定性评分器分离了缺陷召回率、干净对照误报率、证据定位准确性和修复相关性。基于四个文本端点的1440次缓存审计，主要DeepSeek审计器实现了100.0%的闭环和干净感知代码召回率，但开放提示导致93.8%的干净代码对照被误标，即使在召回饱和的情况下，干净感知全三指标特异性也仅为87.5%。引入干净感知警告将DeepSeek代码误报从20.8%（95%置信区间11.7–34.3）降至0.0%（0.0–7.4），而召回率不变；预算锚定仍会在相同提示下标记48个干净对照中的38个。仅报告召回率会使得这四个模型排名相同；而报告干净对照率则可将它们区分达79分之差。

summary: Evaluating open-ended text generation involves understanding how different properties of a continuation relate to its perceived quality. We present a reference-based framework for examining coherence and diversity through three perspectives: aligning their evolution with human trajectories, comparing their summaries with a human continuation of the same prompt, and estimating their likelihood under a human reference distribution. Experiments with human quality ratings suggest that diversity-based alignment and mean-based comparisons capture quality-related variation, although the comparisons do not establish a predictive advantage for temporal alignment over simpler baselines. Reference likelihood also shows positive associations with ratings, with results varying across reference configurations and scoring horizons. Together, these analyses provide a structured way to examine how measured coherence and diversity relate to human judgments, while distinguishing similarity to human references from quality itself. Code and analysis resources are available at https://github.com/EstebanGarces/likely_human.
title: Reference-Based Analysis of Coherence and Diversity in Open-Ended Text Generation
title_translated: 基于参考的开放式文本生成连贯性与多样性分析
summary_translated: 评估开放式文本生成需要理解不同延续属性如何影响其感知质量。我们提出一种基于参考的框架，从三个视角考察连贯性与多样性：追踪其演化与人类轨迹的一致性，将它们的摘要与同一提示的人类延续进行比较，以及估计其在人类参考分布下的概率。结合人类质量评分的实验表明，基于多样性的对齐和基于均值的比较能够捕捉与质量相关的变异，尽管比较并未证明时间对齐相对于简单基线具有预测优势。参考似然性也与评分呈正相关，但结果随参考配置和评分时长而异。这些分析共同提供了一种结构化方式，以考察测量的连贯性与多样性如何与人类判断相关联，同时区分与人类参考的相似性与质量本身。

summary: Self-supervised speech models encode rich phonetic information, but it remains unclear how to transform this information into interpretable metrics for second-language (L2) pronunciation assessment in spontaneous speech. We propose a native-reference coordinate geometry in which phone-class averages from native speech define a low-dimensional reference subspace, and L2 speech is evaluated by its distance to matching native phone-class coordinates. Unlike prior distance-based approaches, our method does not require parallel recordings with matched linguistic content or dedicated pronunciation labels. Across different self-supervised encoders and modeling choices, the resulting native-reference distances show negative Spearman correlations up to -0.5 with speaking proficiency, indicating that higher-proficiency speakers tend to lie closer to the native-reference space.
title: A Native-Reference Coordinate Geometry for L2 Pronunciation Deviation Using Self-Supervised Speech Models
title_translated: 利用自监督语音模型实现第二语言发音偏差的原生参考坐标几何
summary_translated: 自监督语音模型编码丰富的语音信息，但如何将这些信息转化为自然口语中第二语言（L2）发音评估的可解释度量仍不明确。我们提出一种原生参考坐标几何方法：以母语语音中音位类的平均值定义低维参考子空间，L2语音则通过其与对应母语音位类坐标的距离进行评估。与以往基于距离的方法不同，本方法无需平行录音或专门的发音标注。在不同自监督编码器和建模选择下，所得原生参考距离与说话者熟练度呈现高达-0.5的负Spearman相关性，表明高熟练度说话者通常更接近母语参考空间。

summary: Modern information retrieval (IR) systems rarely represent time, yet many information needs depend on it: in clinical, journalistic, and legal search, when an event occurred can decide whether a document is relevant. Dense retrievers and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines match queries to documents well on topic but poorly on time, so they surface content that is on-topic yet temporally wrong. We introduce Temporal Textual Similarity (TTS), a task that measures how well two anchored texts align in time, independent of their topical similarity. We then present TEMPS (Temporal Embedding Model for Precise Search), a modular temporal branch that attaches to a frozen semantic retriever and trains on that signal. It resolves anchored temporal expressions to intervals and moment-matches each one to a Gaussian; the resulting ordering supervises an anchor-date-conditioned encoder, whose score we fuse with the semantic score at inference. Grounding supplies the supervision, so training uses no hand-labeled temporal data. The temporal score itself is the Gaussian-KL inclusion measure from distributional embeddings; what TEMPS adds is the grounding and the moment-matched supervision. On three temporal benchmarks, TEMPS improves MRR for every semantic backbone tested and, on TS- Retriever, lifts R@1 from 19.92 to 25.39 over the prior temporal state of the art.
title: TEMPS: Temporal Sentence Embeddings for Temporal Information Retrieval
title_translated: TEMPS：用于时间信息检索的时间句子嵌入
summary_translated: 现代信息检索（IR）系统很少考虑时间因素，然而许多信息需求都依赖于时间：在临床、新闻和法律搜索中，事件发生的时间可能决定文档的相关性。密集型检索器和检索增强生成（RAG）流水线在主题匹配上表现良好，但在时间匹配上表现不佳，导致返回的内容虽然主题相关但时间错误。我们提出了时间文本相似性（TTS）任务，用于衡量两个带有时间锚点的文本在时间上的对齐程度，而不受其主题相似性的影响。随后，我们提出TEMPS（精确搜索的时间嵌入模型），一个可模块化附加到冻结语义检索器上的时间分支，并基于该信号进行训练。它将时间锚点表达解析为时间区间，并将每个区间与高斯分布进行匹配；由此产生的排序监督了一个以锚点日期为条件的编码器，其得分在推理时与语义得分融合。通过基于事实的监督，训练过程无需人工标注的时间数据。时间得分本身来自分布嵌入中的高斯KL包含度量；TEMPS新增的是基于事实的锚定和匹配监督机制。在三个时间基准测试中，TEMPS提升了所有测试的语义主干模型的MRR，且在TS-Retriever上，将R@1从先前最先进的19.92提升至25.39。

summary: Conference policies distinguish using Large Language Models (LLMs) to polish one's own review from delegating the critique, but current Artificial Text Detection (ATD) methods largely measure surface form rather than the origin of its content. We instead measure the external information carried by a review: information not explained by the reviewed paper and a generic reviewing instruction. We propose Self-Conditioning, an unsupervised information-theoretic estimator that compares the likelihood of a review under its production context with its likelihood when that context is augmented with hints extracted from the review itself. On the IntelLabs peer-review benchmark, Self-Conditioning separates fully-delegated from machine-polished reviews with AUC up to $1.0$ while remaining largely insensitive to surface rewriting. Moreover, as generators receive increasing amounts of externally-provided information, their scores move monotonically towards the human regime, unlike standard ATD baselines. High-temperature sampling can evade the estimator, but at the cost of output quality.
title: How Much Were You Told? Measuring External Information in Peer Reviews
title_translated: 你被告知了多少？测量同行评审中的外部信息
summary_translated: 会议政策区分使用大语言模型（LLMs）润色自己评审内容与委托他人进行批评的行为，但当前的人工文本检测（ATD）方法主要衡量表面形式而非内容来源。我们则关注评审中携带的外部信息：即无法由被评论文和通用评审说明解释的信息。我们提出自条件法（Self-Conditioning），一种无监督的信息论估计器，通过比较评审在原始生成上下文下的可能性与其在引入从评审自身提取提示后的上下文下的可能性来衡量。在IntelLabs同行评审基准上，自条件法能以高达1.0的AUC值区分完全委托与机器润色的评审，同时对表面重写不敏感。此外，随着生成器获得越来越多外部提供信息，其得分单调趋近人类水平，而标准ATD基线则不具备此特性。高温采样可规避该估计器，但代价是输出质量下降。

summary: We investigate whether state-of-the-art large language models (LLMs) generate feedback that reflects the pedagogical practices of expert teachers in terms of feedback focus and adaptivity. Previous evaluation efforts have examined feedback characteristics, its impact on learning, and its target, yet the focus of feedback and its adaptivity remains largely overlooked. To bridge this gap, we adopt and refine Narciss's taxonomy into seven feedback focus types to annotate teacher and LLM-generated feedback across three university writing courses. We release FeedType, a benchmark containing annotated teacher and LLM feedback from six LLMs under three prompting strategies. We assess the coverage and distribution of feedback focus types, and examine whether LLMs adapt their feedback across draft stages and student performance levels as an expert instructor does. Our findings show that while most LLMs cover most feedback focus types, they fail to reflect teacher feedback distributions and show varying levels of adaptivity, with none matching the teachers' adaptive behavior. We believe FeedType will support future research on pedagogical alignment in LLM feedback generation.
title: Evaluating Feedback Focus and Pedagogical Adaptivity in LLM-Generated Feedback on Student Writing
title_translated: 评估大语言模型生成的学生写作反馈中的反馈焦点与教学适应性
summary_translated: 我们研究了当前最先进的大语言模型（LLMs）生成的反馈是否反映了专家教师在反馈焦点和适应性方面的教学实践。以往的评估工作关注反馈特征、学习影响及其目标，但对反馈焦点及其适应性仍缺乏足够关注。为弥补这一空白，我们将Narciss的分类体系改进为七种反馈焦点类型，用于标注三所大学写作课程中教师与LLM生成的反馈。我们发布了FeedType基准，包含六种LLM在三种提示策略下生成的教师与LLM反馈的标注数据。我们评估了反馈焦点类型的覆盖范围与分布，并考察LLM是否像专家导师一样，根据写作阶段和学生表现水平调整反馈。研究发现，尽管大多数LLM覆盖了大部分反馈焦点类型，但未能反映教师反馈的分布模式，且适应性水平各异，没有一种能匹配教师的适应行为。我们认为FeedType将支持未来关于LLM反馈生成中教学对齐的研究。

summary: Most Turkish-capable large language models (LLMs) are evaluated using general-purpose benchmarks rather than long, structurally complex domain documents. This paper evaluates five open-weight 7B-8B models for Turkish document question answering under a resource-constrained local deployment setting. The primary benchmark contains 100 systematically validated questions derived from a 109-page industrial R&D report, and the evaluation protocol is replicated using a second 112-page public-sector report and an independently constructed 100-question set. All models are evaluated locally on an NVIDIA RTX 3050 laptop GPU with 6 GB VRAM using controlled prompting, decoding, and 4-bit quantisation.   The principal methodological contribution is an evidence-annotated evaluation protocol that separates retrieval failure from downstream model reasoning failure without requiring additional model calls. On the primary benchmark, end-to-end accuracy ranges from 49% to 75%. Seven lexical, dense, and hybrid retrieval configurations are additionally compared using 95% Wilson intervals and exact paired McNemar tests; none significantly outperforms the character TF-IDF baseline on either document. Evidence recall saturates differently across the two reports, showing that retrieval and effective context capacity can be binding constraints for some documents but not others. These results demonstrate that model selection, retrieval behaviour, and hardware limits must be evaluated separately when deploying open-weight LLMs for Turkish domain documents.
title: Evaluating Open-Weight LLMs for Turkish Domain Documents Under Retrieval and Hardware Constraints
title_translated: 在检索与硬件约束下评估开放权重大语言模型对土耳其领域文档的表现
summary_translated: 大多数具备土耳其语能力的大语言模型使用通用基准进行评估，而非针对长篇、结构复杂的领域文档。本文在资源受限的本地部署环境下，评估了五款7B-8B规模的开放权重模型在土耳其文档问答任务中的表现。主要基准包含100个系统验证的问题，源自一篇109页的工业研发报告；评估协议还使用第二份112页的公共部门报告及独立构建的100个问题集进行了复现。所有模型均在配备6GB VRAM的NVIDIA RTX 3050笔记本GPU上本地运行，采用受控提示、解码和4位量化。主要方法论贡献是一个证据标注的评估协议，可在不增加额外模型调用的情况下，分离检索失败与下游模型推理失败。在主要基准上，端到端准确率介于49%至75%之间。我们进一步比较了七种词汇、密集和混合检索配置，使用95%威尔逊区间和精确配对McNemar检验；在任一文档上均无显著优于字符TF-IDF基线的方法。证据召回率在两份报告中表现出不同饱和趋势，表明检索能力和有效上下文容量对某些文档是关键约束，而对其他文档则不是。这些结果表明，在部署开放权重LLM处理土耳其领域文档时，必须分别评估模型选择、检索行为和硬件限制。

summary: Effective summarization of interrogative dialogues is a critical task in forensic and investigative settings, requiring high factual accuracy, coherence, and attribute-specific relevance. In this work, we introduce CASPER, a novel Chain-of-Thought Attribute-Specific Prompting for Evaluative Summarization framework that leverages structured prompting and iterative refinement to generate high-quality summaries of interrogator-witness interactions. We construct MINDSum, a dataset extending the MIND corpus, comprising 6,000 utterance pairs annotated with event details, factual statements, character descriptions, and fillers. CASPER employs RoleEval, a hierarchical evaluation mechanism where multiple roles (officer, inspector, senior inspector) iteratively assess summaries based on predefined criteria. By integrating entity extraction and structured feedback loops, CASPER significantly improves factual consistency and contextual completeness compared to existing baselines. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework outperforms standard summarization models on both lexical (ROUGE) and semantic (BERTScore) metrics, while human evaluation confirms its alignment with expert reasoning. Our findings underscore the potential of controlled summarization in high-stakes domains, paving the way for AI-driven forensic intelligence.
title: Controlled Attribute-Specific Summarization of Interrogative Dialogues
title_translated: 对话式问答的可控属性特定摘要生成
summary_translated: 在法务和调查场景中，对话式问答的有效摘要是一项关键任务，要求高度的事实准确性、连贯性和属性特定相关性。本文提出CASPER框架——一种基于思维链的属性特定提示评估摘要方法，利用结构化提示和迭代优化，生成高质量的审讯员-证人互动摘要。我们构建了MINDSum数据集，扩展自MIND语料库，包含6,000对已标注事件细节、事实陈述、人物描述和填充项的对话片段。CASPER采用RoleEval机制，由多个角色（警官、督察、高级督察）分层评估摘要，依据预设标准进行迭代判断。通过整合实体抽取与结构化反馈循环，CASPER显著提升了事实一致性与上下文完整性，优于现有基线模型。实验结果表明，我们的框架在词法（ROUGE）和语义（BERTScore）指标上均优于标准摘要模型，且人工评估确认其与专家推理高度一致。研究结果凸显了在高风险领域中可控摘要的潜力，为AI驱动的法务情报发展铺平道路。

summary: KV-cache eviction is typically evaluated through average quality-memory trade-offs, yet a small average loss can hide requests whose utility degrades materially. We reformulate eviction as a deployment risk-control problem: a material degradation occurs when eviction lowers task utility by more than a deployment-specified tolerance relative to full-KV inference on the same request, and deployment risk is the population frequency of such events. Given a reliability contract specifying a target risk level and confidence requirement, we use a compressor-agnostic post-hoc certification procedure to select a retention policy from calibration data with a finite-sample guarantee, falling back to full KV when no compressed policy is certified. Across multiple eviction methods, Llama and Mistral models, and LongBench and RULER-32K, the same contract supports substantially different levels of eviction: on Llama, it certifies SnapKV at 75% retention on LongBench but no tested compressed policy on RULER-32K, triggering full-KV fallback. Policies with empirical degradation rates below the 5% target can still fail finite-sample certification; on Llama LongBench, empirical thresholding selects uncertified policies that retain 5-10 percentage points less cache across fixed-budget methods. The proposed framework converts a deployment-level reliability requirement into a KV-memory operating point.
title: Risk-Controlled KV-Cache Eviction: From Memory Budgets to Risk Targets
title_translated: 风险控制的KV缓存淘汰：从内存预算到风险目标
summary_translated: KV缓存淘汰通常通过平均质量-内存权衡来评估，但平均损失较小可能掩盖了任务效用显著下降的请求。我们将淘汰问题重新定义为部署风险控制问题：当淘汰导致任务效用相对于同一请求的完整KV推理下降超过部署指定的容差时，即发生实质性退化，而部署风险则是此类事件的发生频率。在给定可靠性合同（指定目标风险水平和置信度要求）的前提下，我们使用一种与压缩器无关的后验认证方法，基于校准数据选择一个保留策略，并提供有限样本保证；若无压缩策略被认证，则回退至完整KV。在多种淘汰方法、Llama和Mistral模型以及LongBench和RULER-32K数据集上，相同的合同支持截然不同的淘汰程度：在Llama上，该合同在LongBench上认证SnapKV在75%保留率下有效，但在RULER-32K上未认证任何测试压缩策略，触发完整KV回退。即使经验退化率低于5%的目标，某些策略仍可能因有限样本认证失败；在Llama LongBench上，经验阈值选择的策略虽低于目标，但其缓存保留率仍比固定预算方法低5-10个百分点。所提出的框架将部署级别的可靠性要求转化为KV内存的操作点。

summary: Pruning large pre-trained transformer-based ASR models such as OpenAI's Whisper has seen great adoption, as pruning the decoder led to significant end-to-end transcription speedups. For instance, the {\tt whisper-large-v3-turbo} variant reduced the decoder from 32 to 4 layers, while Distill-Whisper similarly reduced the decoder to only 2 layers. Although some attention has been put towards reducing the size of the encoder, no approach has seen wide adoption. This could be due to the need for custom inference implementations to take advantage of the compressed model. We present an approach that ranks encoder layers by the leave-one-layer-out change in Word Error Rate (WER). The six layers that cause the least change are removed, corresponding to $18.5\%$ of the encoder stack. The pruned model requires no custom inference code as it is simply a more shallow encoder with fewer layers. We further distill using unlabeled monolingual speech data to recover performance degradation caused by the zero-shot layer pruning. Mean WER across four languages increases to $20.1\%$ after distillation, compared to $21.9\%$ zero-shot, going from a baseline of $18.2\%$. We release all of our code (https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune) and the pruned model (https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-large-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned).
title: Six Layers Less: Encoder Pruning for Whisper with Label-Free Recovery

title_translated: 六层更少：基于无标签恢复的Whisper编码器剪枝
summary_translated: 对OpenAI的Whisper等大型预训练Transformer语音识别模型进行剪枝已得到广泛应用，因为剪枝解码器可显著提升端到端转录速度。例如，{	t whisper-large-v3-turbo}变体将解码器从32层减少到4层，Distill-Whisper也仅保留2层解码器。尽管已有研究关注编码器尺寸缩减，但尚未有方法广泛采用，这可能是因为需要定制推理实现才能利用压缩模型。我们提出一种基于移除单层后词错误率（WER）变化量来排序编码器层的方法。移除造成最小变化的六层，相当于减少了编码器堆栈的18.5%。剪枝后的模型无需定制推理代码，仅需一个层数更少的浅层编码器即可。此外，我们还使用无标签单语语音数据进行进一步蒸馏，以恢复零样本剪枝带来的性能下降。在四种语言上的平均WER在蒸馏后降至20.1%，相比零样本的21.9%有所改善，基准值为18.2%。我们已公开全部代码（https://github.com/rasgaard/whisper-encoder-layer-prune）和剪枝模型（https://huggingface.co/rasgaard/whisper-large-v3-turbo-encoder-pruned）。

summary: Natural language processing (NLP) applied to open-ended teaching-evaluation comments (Student Evaluation of Teaching, SET) has tracked the field's technical evolution--from lexicons and conventional classifiers to transformers and large language models (LLMs)--but it is not evident that this technical diversification has been accompanied by corresponding gains in educational value and robustness of the evidence. This scoping review (PRISMA-ScR) maps 421 studies (2015-2026, 2026 partial) along a technical axis (RQ1) and four value dimensions (RQ2-RQ5). Dual mutually blinded LLM screening with sampled human adjudication coded seven extraction domains, with targeted codebook-boundary review at synthesis. The joint map's sharpest quantified gap is the actionability discontinuity: demonstrated output or stronger (A2+: 258/421; 61.3%) versus intended-user evaluation or stronger (A3+: 49/421; 11.6%), a 49.7 percentage-point drop. Sentiment analysis remains the modal task (300/421); diagnostic and generative depth is a substantial minority (D4-D5: 28.2% of resolved cases); a formal fairness metric is rare (1.9%). The findings are descriptive and do not support causal claims of progress: technological coexistence and uneven reporting are part of the map, but the A2+ to A3+ cliff is the contribution, not a quality ladder.
title: From Sentiment Classification to Actionable and Responsible Feedback: A Scoping Review and Evidence Map of NLP in Student Evaluation of Teaching, 2015-2026
title_translated: 从情感分类到可操作且负责任的反馈：2015–2026年NLP在教学评价中的范围综述与证据图谱
summary_translated: 自然语言处理（NLP）应用于开放式教学评价评论（学生教学评价，SET）已追踪该领域的技术演进——从词典和传统分类器发展到Transformer和大语言模型（LLMs）——但这种技术多样化是否带来了相应的教育价值提升和证据稳健性尚不明确。本范围综述（PRISMA-ScR）沿技术轴线（RQ1）及四个价值维度（RQ2-RQ5）映射了421项研究（2015–2026，截至2026年部分）。采用双盲LLM筛选结合抽样人工仲裁的方式，编码七个提取领域，并在综合阶段进行目标代码本边界审查。联合图谱中最显著的量化差距是“可操作性断层”：展示输出或更强（A2+: 258/421；61.3%）与预期用户评估或更强（A3+: 49/421；11.6%）之间存在49.7个百分点的落差。情感分析仍是主导任务（300/421）；诊断与生成深度为次要部分（D4-D5：28.2%的已解决案例）；正式公平性度量极为罕见（1.9%）。研究结果为描述性，不支持进步的因果主张：技术共存与报告不均是图谱的一部分，但A2+到A3+的断崖式下降才是核心贡献，而非质量阶梯。

summary: Language models can over-condition on irrelevant preceding text: predictions already supported by local context may still change when distant, unrelated prefix tokens are perturbed. This interference is especially consequential in long, packed, or distractor-heavy contexts, where useful evidence and irrelevant spans coexist. We propose Selective Prefix Anti-Interference Regularization (SPAR), a pretraining objective for selective anti-interference. SPAR runs the original sequence and a corrupt-prefix input in which only the far prefix is changed, then uses a short-context sufficiency gate and a gated KL objective to stabilize locally supported suffix predictions. The gate operationalizes a model-based estimate of whether the far prefix supplies additional information about the target token. Mechanism analyses show that the gate identifies locally sufficient tokens and sharply reduces prefix sensitivity on gate-selected suffix tokens. In continued training on pretrained base models, SPAR improves RULER across Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-3B, Llama-3.2-1B, Llama-3.1-8B, and GPT2-XL under equal counted training compute; pretraining experiments further show gains on both RULER and NoLiMa. These results show that selective anti-interference is an effective objective-level signal for robust context use.
title: Learning When Not to Listen: Selective Anti-Interference Pretraining for Language Models
title_translated: 学会何时不听：用于语言模型的选择性抗干扰预训练
summary_translated: 语言模型可能过度依赖无关的先前文本：即使预测已被局部上下文充分支持，当远距离、无关的前缀标记被扰动时，预测仍可能发生改变。这种干扰在长序列、密集打包或干扰项繁多的上下文中尤为严重，其中有效信息与无关片段共存。我们提出选择性前缀抗干扰正则化（SPAR），一种用于选择性抗干扰的预训练目标。SPAR同时运行原始序列和仅远端前缀被修改的污染输入，利用短上下文充分性门控机制和门控KL目标，稳定局部支持的后续预测。该门控机制实现了模型对远端前缀是否为目标标记提供额外信息的估计。机制分析表明，该门控能识别局部充分的标记，并显著降低门控选择的后续标记对前缀的敏感性。在预训练基础模型上的持续训练中，SPAR在同等计算量下提升了Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen2.5-3B、Llama-3.2-1B、Llama-3.1-8B和GPT2-XL在RULER上的表现；预训练实验进一步显示在RULER和NoLiMa上均有提升。这些结果表明，选择性抗干扰是一种有效的目标级信号，有助于实现鲁棒的上下文使用。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent systems where a principal agent decomposes tasks and delegates them to subordinate agents that may invoke external tools. Safety alignment, however, is still evaluated almost exclusively under a single-agent threat model, treating safety as a property of the individual LLM. We show that this assumption breaks down: \emph{individual safety alignment fails to transfer to multi-agent settings}. Two failure mechanisms emerge under delegation: \emph{responsibility diffusion} on the principal side and \emph{role-bias compliance} on the subordinate side, jointly converting language-level refusal into actionable harm. We refer to this phenomenon as \textit{delegated misalignment} and study it through a three-condition protocol across 6 frontier LLMs on 49 hazardous tasks. Delegation amplifies end-to-end harm substantially: DeepSeek-V3.2's full-execution rate rises from 30.6\% to 77.6\% once delegation is introduced, and the same model behaves very differently across roles (GPT-5: 22.5\% as a single agent vs.\ 61.2\% as a subordinate). Ablations further show that standard single-layer defenses each fail on their own and can even backfire. We call on the community to move beyond per-model alignment and toward composite safety mechanisms before multi-agent LLM systems are deployed at scale.
title: Delegated Misalignment: How Multi-Agent Structures Amplify LLM Safety Risks
title_translated: 委托错位：多智能体结构如何放大LLM安全风险
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地部署于多智能体系统中，其中主智能体将任务分解并委派给下属智能体，后者可能调用外部工具。然而，安全对齐仍几乎完全在单智能体威胁模型下评估，将安全视为单一LLM的属性。我们发现这一假设失效：	extit{个体安全对齐无法转移到多智能体环境中}。在委托机制下出现两种失败机制：主智能体侧的	extit{责任扩散}和下属智能体侧的	extit{角色偏见顺从}，二者共同将语言层面的拒绝行为转化为实际危害。我们将此现象称为	extit{委托错位}，并通过在6个前沿LLM上对49个危险任务执行三条件协议进行研究。委托显著放大了端到端危害：DeepSeek-V3.2的完整执行率从30.6%上升至77.6%；同一模型在不同角色下的行为差异巨大（GPT-5：作为单智能体为22.5%，作为下属为61.2%）。消融实验进一步表明，标准单层防御各自独立均会失败，甚至可能适得其反。我们呼吁社区超越单模型对齐，转向复合型安全机制，以避免大规模部署多智能体LLM系统前的风险。

summary: Generative AI is rapidly entering adolescents' everyday lives during a critical period of cognitive, social and emotional development. Yet its adoption is outpacing evidence on how adolescents themselves experience, understand and negotiate its expanding role in their lives. We examined AI-related discourse on r/teenagers from January 2023 to July 2026 using validated keyword-based retrieval and a human-in-the-loop, LLM-assisted thematic analysis. AI-related discussion increased substantially over time, and 11,083 analytically coded posts revealed eight interconnected domains of experience. Everyday and social use was most prevalent (36.8 percent), while discourse increasingly shifted toward authenticity, personal control and safety, and future human roles. Across domains, adolescents questioned when AI should support or substitute for human thinking and creativity, how conversational AI changes relationships and perceptions of agency, what can still be considered authentic, who controls personal information and representation, and what opportunities and roles should remain human. These findings position adolescent AI use not simply as technology adoption, but as an emerging negotiation over AI's place and boundaries in everyday life. Supporting this transition will require developmentally appropriate AI literacy, psychological and social support, and AI systems and policies that protect adolescents' agency, privacy, relationships and opportunities for human development.
title: "AI Is Turning Too Human": How Teenagers Experience and Negotiate AI in Everyday Life
title_translated: AI正在变得过于人性化：青少年如何在日常生活中体验和协商人工智能
summary_translated: 生成式人工智能正迅速进入青少年的日常生活，而这一时期正是认知、社交和情感发展的关键阶段。然而，其应用速度已超过关于青少年自身如何体验、理解并协商其在生活中的角色的相关证据。我们通过使用经过验证的关键词检索方法，并结合人工参与的LLM辅助主题分析，研究了从2023年1月到2026年7月r/teenagers社区中与AI相关的讨论。AI相关讨论随时间显著增加，共分析编码了11,083条帖子，揭示出八个相互关联的经验领域。日常和社交使用最为普遍（占36.8%），而讨论内容逐渐转向真实性、个人控制权、安全性以及未来人类的角色。在各个领域中，青少年质疑AI应在何时支持或替代人类思维与创造力，对话式AI如何改变人际关系和代理感知，何者仍可被视为真实，谁应掌控个人信息与形象表达，以及哪些机会和角色应保留在人类手中。这些发现表明，青少年对AI的使用不仅是技术采纳，更是一种关于AI在日常生活中地位与边界的新协商过程。支持这一过渡需要发展适宜年龄的AI素养教育、心理与社会支持，以及能够保护青少年自主性、隐私、人际关系和人类发展机会的AI系统与政策。

summary: In statutory question answering, every claim must be traceable to evidence, not merely relevant, since unverifiable labour-rights answers carry serious legal consequences. Current systems fall short: single-pass RAG cannot detect insufficient evidence, while multi-agent legal-debate systems treat grounding as a prompting convention, letting agents cite unretrieved evidence. To address this gap, we introduce LabourCrew, a multi-agent RAG framework built around three grounding mechanisms: StatuteGraph, a graph index that explicitly links chapter, section, proviso, and cross-reference structure rather than fixed-length spans; an Evidence Exchange Protocol that confines advocates and an interpreter to an evidence ledger, making citation to unretrieved text impossible, while a fault-tolerant supervisor board runs advocates in parallel so individual failures degrade rather than crash the system; and a Calibrated Trust Gate that replaces categorical accept/reject decisions with a trust score, thresholded via conformal risk control for a distribution-free bound on the false-accept rate. We evaluate on LabourActQA, a 500-item Bangla question set from the Bangladesh Labour Act, 2006, spanning seven reasoning categories and three difficulty tiers. The framework drives the empirical false-accept rate to 0.081, within the target level ($α= 0.10$), achieves the highest Answer Relevancy among HyDE RAG, Graph-RAG, and Hierarchical RAG (0.862 $>$ 0.839, 0.815, 0.828), and degrades gradually rather than catastrophically as question difficulty increases. These results show that calibrated abstention, not retrieval quality alone, is what makes legal question answering auditable in low-resource statutory domains.
title: LabourCrew: A Multi-Agent RAG Framework for Trustworthy Adversarial Deliberation and Statutory Reasoning over Labour Law
title_translated: LabourCrew：面向劳动法可信对抗性审议与法定推理的多智能体RAG框架
summary_translated: 在法律条文问答中，每一项主张都必须有可追溯的证据支持，而不仅仅是相关，因为不可验证的劳工权利回答将带来严重的法律后果。当前系统存在不足：单次传递的RAG无法检测证据不足，而多智能体法律辩论系统则将证据基础视为提示惯例，允许智能体引用未检索到的内容。为弥补这一差距，我们提出LabourCrew——一个围绕三种证据机制构建的多智能体RAG框架：StatuteGraph，一种显式链接章节、条款、但书及交叉引用结构的图索引，而非固定长度片段；证据交换协议，将辩护方和解释者限制在证据账本内，使引用未检索文本成为不可能，同时容错型监督委员会并行运行辩护方，确保个别失败仅导致性能下降而非系统崩溃；校准信任门控，以信任评分取代二元接受/拒绝决策，通过符合风险控制实现对误接受率的无分布边界。我们在LabourActQA上进行评估，该数据集包含来自2006年孟加拉国劳动法的500个问题，涵盖七个推理类别和三个难度层级。该框架将实证误接受率降至0.081，达到目标水平（α=0.10），在HyDE RAG、Graph-RAG和Hierarchical RAG中实现了最高的答案相关性（0.862 > 0.839, 0.815, 0.828），且随着问题难度上升时表现渐进退化而非灾难性崩溃。结果表明，在低资源法律领域中，可信的审计能力取决于校准后的弃权机制，而非仅依赖检索质量。

summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) move from conversational assistants to advanced agentic systems, guardrail failures can convert adversarial intents into harmful executions. However, most guardrail evaluation frameworks focus only on the result and assess whether a user request is safe or unsafe. This approach is insufficient for multi-turn failures, where adversarial intent is distributed across multiple turns. This motivates us to go beyond detection to identify the turns and tokens that push the conversation toward unsafe trajectories. To support this, we construct a multi-turn dataset with behavioral validation and tiered evidence supervision. The dataset contains 1,762 conversations, including adversarial conversations, benign twins, and benign variants with high-risk vocabulary. We train a lightweight hierarchical attribution model that predicts safety violations and attributes them to contributing user turns and token spans. The model achieves strong detection performance (F1=0.988), and removing the top 15% of attributed tokens reduces the adversarial classification confidence by 51.1%. The model preserves low false positive rates on benign conversations with high-risk vocabulary, with false positives below 1% on both borderline benign and benign high-risk vocabulary conversations, compared to 37.3% and 94.7% for a keyword-based surface-risk baseline. Independent human annotation supports the model's attribution performance, with the top-five attributed turns containing a human-identified evidence-bearing turn in 84.5% of adversarial cases.
title: Beyond Unsafe Detection: Counterfactually Anchored Evidence Attribution for Multi-Turn LLM Safety Failures

title_translated: 超越不安全检测：基于反事实锚定证据归因的多轮LLM安全失效分析
summary_translated: 随着大型语言模型（LLMs）从对话助手演变为高级代理系统，防护机制的失效可能将恶意意图转化为有害执行。然而，大多数防护评估框架仅关注结果，判断用户请求是否安全或不安全。这种做法对于多轮失效场景不足，因为恶意意图可能分散在多个交互回合中。因此，我们提出超越检测，识别推动对话走向不安全轨迹的具体回合和词元。为此，我们构建了一个包含行为验证和分层证据监督的多轮数据集。该数据集包含1,762个对话，包括恶意对话、良性对照组以及含有高风险词汇的良性变体。我们训练了一个轻量级层次化归因模型，用于预测安全违规并将其归因于相关用户回合和词元段。该模型表现出优异的检测性能（F1=0.988），移除前15%被归因的词元后，恶意分类置信度下降51.1%。该模型在含有高风险词汇的良性对话中保持极低的误报率，误报率低于1%（在边缘良性和高风险词汇良性对话中），而基于关键词的表面风险基线分别为37.3%和94.7%。独立的人类标注支持模型的归因效果，84.5%的恶意案例中，前五个被归因的回合包含人类识别出的证据承载回合。

summary: Autonomous web agents, powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), have garnered significant attention for automating various web-based tasks with multi-step reasoning and decision-making capabilities. An open research question in the development of these agents lies in the format of the webpage input. Raw HTML source code, with its extensive and often irrelevant details, poses difficulties for LLMs with limited context windows. To address this challenge, we first reproduce baseline models such as GPT-3.5 and LLaMA-2-70B on the WebArena (Zhou et al., 2023) benchmark, identifying common failure modes. We then propose two retrieval strategies to filter out irrelevant context for LLM agents. We develop DeBERTa-based and T5-based models that rank HTML elements by their relevance to the task. We fine-tune them on Mind2Web trajectory data and transfer them to WebArena. Experiments show that our DeBERTa-based model improves the success rate of the LLaMA-2-70B LLM agent on WebArena from 1.97% to 2.96%. Moreover, we develop a zero-shot ColBERT-based retriever that is able to retrieve the ground-truth element with a recall of 0.52 on Mind2Web and 0.47 on WebArena.
title: Improving LLM-based Autonomous Web Agents with Filtering

title_translated: 通过过滤提升基于LLM的自主网络代理性能
summary_translated: 由大型语言模型（LLMs）驱动的自主网络代理因其具备多步推理与决策能力，已在自动化各类网络任务方面受到广泛关注。当前开发中的一个开放性研究问题是网页输入的格式。原始HTML源代码包含大量冗余信息，对上下文窗口有限的LLMs构成挑战。为应对这一挑战，我们首先在WebArena（Zhou等，2023）基准上复现GPT-3.5和LLaMA-2-70B等基线模型，识别出常见失败模式。随后，我们提出两种检索策略，用于过滤LLM代理的无关上下文。我们开发了基于DeBERTa和T5的模型，根据任务相关性对HTML元素进行排序。在Mind2Web轨迹数据上进行微调，并迁移至WebArena。实验表明，我们的DeBERTa模型将LLaMA-2-70B代理在WebArena上的成功率从1.97%提升至2.96%。此外，我们还开发了一个零样本ColBERT检索器，在Mind2Web上的召回率为0.52，在WebArena上为0.47。

summary: Safety alignment in large language models is trained primarily in English, and recent work reports that the underlying harmfulness representation survives translation: English-trained probes separate harmful from harmless prompts almost as well in low-resource languages as in English. This has been taken as evidence that cross-lingual refusal failures mainly reflect calibration rather than representation quality. We show that this conclusion depends on the choice of negative examples. Across nine languages spanning three resource tiers, we replicate near-perfect transfer (AUROC > 0.98) when harmless prompts come from an unrelated distribution (easy negatives). With XSTest contrast prompts, which are benign but surface-similar to harmful requests (hard negatives), transfer collapses in low-resource languages while remaining largely stable in high-resource languages. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, mean AUROC drop increases from 0.003 in English to 0.017 in high-resource, 0.042 in mid-resource, and 0.276 in low-resource languages. The pattern replicates on Aya Expanse. Back-translation chrF controls and a matched-chrF comparison across three languages reduce the likelihood that translation quality explains the effect. The collapse remains after controlling for chrF (partial r = 0.70, p = 0.03). Tokenizer fertility correlates with the collapse and explains part of the resource-tier effect, but not all of it. The results show that easy-negative transfer can coexist with substantial degradation under hard negatives. Easy-negative evaluation alone therefore cannot establish that the harmfulness representation survives translation.
title: Hard Negatives Reveal What Easy Negatives Hide: Cross-Lingual Harmfulness Representations Degrade with Resource Tier Under Hard Negatives
title_translated: 硬负例揭示了易负例所掩盖的内容：跨语言有害性表征在硬负例下随资源层级下降而退化
summary_translated: 大型语言模型的安全对齐主要在英语中训练，近期研究表明，底层有害性表征在翻译后依然有效：用英语训练的探测器在低资源语言中区分有害与无害提示的能力几乎与英语相当。这被视作跨语言拒绝失败主要反映校准问题而非表征质量的证据。我们指出，这一结论依赖于负例的选择。在涵盖三个资源层级的九种语言中，当无害提示来自无关分布（易负例）时，我们复现了近乎完美的迁移（AUROC > 0.98）。但使用XSTest对比提示（表面看似有害但实际无害，即硬负例）时，低资源语言中的迁移能力急剧崩溃，而高资源语言中仍基本稳定。在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，平均AUROC下降从英语的0.003增至高资源语言0.017、中资源0.042、低资源0.276。该模式在Aya Expanse上也得到复现。通过回译chrF控制和三语言匹配chrF比较，排除了翻译质量解释该效应的可能性。即使控制chrF后，该崩溃仍存在（部分相关系数r = 0.70，p = 0.03）。分词器的丰富性与崩溃程度相关，解释了部分资源层级效应，但非全部。结果表明，易负例下的良好迁移可以与硬负例下的显著退化并存。因此，仅依赖易负例评估无法证明有害性表征在翻译后仍然有效。

summary: Human-written agent skills encode rich workflows for real-world problem solving, but are typically used as external inference-time instructions rather than internalized as reusable model capabilities. We introduce \texttt{SkillGym}, a framework that transforms these skills into executable, verifiable training environments for large language model agents. Its skill-to-task pipeline instantiates concrete tasks, verifies outcomes with code-based checkers, and assesses empirical skill dependence through contrastive executions. We construct and release 2,756 environments across 12 categories and collect 8,364 successful trajectories from multiple models and harnesses, averaging 49 tool calls and over 60k logged text tokens. These resources support supervised fine-tuning on verified workflows and reinforcement learning with outcome-based rewards. Under Claude Code, supervised fine-tuning improves Qwen3.5-35B-A3B by 199 Elo on GDPval-AA v2, 19.10 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, and 28.13 and 12.38 points on SkillsBench v1.1 with and without skills, respectively. Our 35B \texttt{SkillGym-Agent} reaches 51.47\% on skill-assisted SkillsBench, exceeding reported scores for Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4 Mini, and DeepSeek V4 Pro. Without skills, it also surpasses skill-assisted bases under Codex and Claude Code, suggesting reusable procedural competence.
title: SkillGym: Internalizing Human Skills into LLMs for Real-World Problem Solving
title_translated: SkillGym：将人类技能内化至大语言模型以解决现实世界问题
summary_translated: 人类编写的智能体技能蕴含了丰富的现实问题解决工作流，但通常仅作为外部推理时的指令使用，而非内化为可复用的模型能力。我们提出 	exttt{SkillGym} 框架，将这些技能转化为可执行、可验证的大语言模型智能体训练环境。其技能到任务的流水线能够实例化具体任务，通过基于代码的检查器验证结果，并通过对比执行评估经验性技能依赖性。我们在12个类别中构建并发布了2,756个环境，从多个模型和工具中收集了8,364条成功轨迹，平均包含49次工具调用和超过6万条日志文本标记。这些资源支持在已验证工作流上的监督微调以及基于结果奖励的强化学习。在Claude Code下，监督微调使Qwen3.5-35B-A3B在GDPval-AA v2上提升199 Elo，在Terminal-Bench 2.1上提升19.10个百分点，在SkillsBench v1.1上（有技能/无技能）分别提升28.13和12.38点。我们的35B 	exttt{SkillGym-Agent} 在技能辅助的SkillsBench上达到51.47%，超越了Claude Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.4 Mini和DeepSeek V4 Pro的报告分数。在无技能情况下，也优于Codex和Claude Code下的技能辅助基线，表明其具备可复用的过程性能力。

summary: Researchers in industry and academia use synthetic survey respondents powered by large language models as substitutes for human samples. These synthetic populations require validation against real-world data, so researchers often address them using ad hoc comparisons with human surveys. Inspired by the intention-behaviour gap in behavioural science, we argue that these validations test the wrong thing for most applied cases where decision makers commission synthetic research to anticipate consequential behaviour. To address this problem, we propose a validation framework with two requirements. First, every validity claim must state its level of correspondence with human data: does the sample predict what the represented people do, which of four diagnostics (location, dispersion, response process and structure) does the validation address, and does the validation compare against experimental effects? Second, researchers must report validity claims for subgroups, since these groups are often the most affected by consequential decisions and aggregate accuracy hides their misrepresentation. Our validation framework operationalises three justice dimensions (distributional, procedural, and recognition) as measurable quantities and defines within-persona counterfactual experiments as a validation requirement. We then apply the framework to electric vehicle charging tariffs, before closing with a reporting checklist that researchers can use to make convincing validity claims.
title: Consequential Behaviour and Representational Fairness in the Validation of Synthetic Research
title_translated: 合成研究验证中的后果行为与表征公平性
summary_translated: 产业界和学术界的 researchers 使用由大语言模型生成的合成调查受访者作为人类样本的替代品。这些合成群体需要与真实世界数据进行验证，因此研究人员通常采用与人类调查的临时比较方式。受行为科学中“意图-行为差距”的启发，我们认为在大多数实际应用中，决策者委托合成研究是为了预测具有后果的行为，而当前的验证方法测试的是错误的内容。为解决此问题，我们提出了一个包含两项要求的验证框架：第一，每个有效性声明必须明确其与人类数据的对应程度——该样本是否能预测所代表人群的实际行为？验证针对的是四个诊断维度（位置、分布、响应过程和结构）中的哪一个？验证是否对比了实验效应？第二，研究人员必须报告子群体的有效性声明，因为这些群体往往最易受到后果性决策的影响，而总体准确率会掩盖其代表性偏差。我们的验证框架将三种正义维度（分配、程序和承认）操作化为可测量量，并将个体内部反事实实验定义为验证要求。随后，我们将该框架应用于电动汽车充电费率的研究，最后提供一份报告清单，帮助研究人员提出有说服力的有效性声明。

summary: Contract inference requires multiple judgments about a shared document, but aggregate accuracy can conceal changes in the individual decisions. Repeated agreement is also insufficient: a model may consistently return the wrong answer. In this paper, we compare Jev with nine language models on ContractNLI, evaluating inference cost, response time, average correctness, and correctness across repeated request conditions. Controlled comparisons vary hypothesis visibility, requested outputs, and output order while keeping the contract and target judgment fixed. Jev has the lowest cost and median response time among the evaluated configurations, while hosted language models achieve higher baseline accuracy. Rankings by baseline accuracy differ from rankings by correctness across every condition and repeat, although small differences in the latter do not establish a general stability advantage. Development diagnostics further reveal compensating corrections and regressions, as well as persistent errors. These findings motivate evaluating cost and response time alongside whether individual judgments remain correct as the request configuration changes. Code: https://github.com/ZF-Utokyo/Jev-Benchmark
title: Same Scores, Different Decisions: Evaluating JEV and Language Models for Legal Document Understanding
title_translated: 相同得分，不同决策：评估JEV与语言模型在法律文档理解中的表现
summary_translated: 合同推断需要对同一文档做出多项判断，但聚合准确率可能掩盖个体判断的变化。重复一致也不足为据：模型可能持续给出错误答案。本文在ContractNLI数据集上对比JEV与九种语言模型，评估推理成本、响应时间、平均正确率以及在重复请求条件下的正确率。受控比较在保持合同和目标判断不变的前提下，改变假设可见性、输出请求内容和输出顺序。JEV在所有评估配置中表现出最低的成本和中位响应时间，而托管语言模型则取得更高的基线准确率。基于基线准确率的排名与在每种条件和重复中基于正确率的排名均不一致，尽管后者的小差异并未确立普遍的稳定性优势。开发诊断进一步揭示了补偿性修正与退化现象，以及持续存在的错误。这些发现促使我们在评估时不仅关注个体判断是否正确，还需同时考虑请求配置变化下的成本与响应时间。代码：https://github.com/ZF-Utokyo/Jev-Benchmark

summary: Small language models (SLMs) are increasingly paired with knowledge graphs (KGs), yet end-to-end KG question answering conflates graph access, search, navigation, reasoning, and answer generation. This coupling makes it difficult both to determine whether an SLM can faithfully execute the reasoning path implied by a question and to attribute failures to navigation rather than to other stages of the pipeline. We isolate this capability by employing the THESEUS navigation and traceability framework and using frozen, off-the-shelf SLMs as local action policies. At each hop, the environment exposes the legal outgoing graph actions, and the model selects one executable graph action and decides whether to stop, without task-specific parameter updates, model-controlled beam search, or free-form answer generation. This controlled setting allows us to evaluate terminal-answer accuracy with Hits@1 together with path fidelity, using Path Edit Distance (PED) as the primary trajectory metric. Across the Kinship and MQuAKE-ST KGQAs, similarly sized local models differ substantially in answer accuracy and path fidelity, with the two metrics sometimes favoring different models. This model-dependent behavior also extends to prompting, as a single demonstrated trajectory can improve or degrade navigation depending on the model. These results motivate evaluating SLM graph reasoning beyond endpoint accuracy alone.
title: The Path Matters: Evaluating Small Language Models Beyond Answer Accuracy in KGQA
